title: Birth date, records and radio at home
summary: Born May 16, 1913, in Milwaukee. He bought his own records and listened to dance bands on an Atwater Kent radio in his room.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And you mentioned records. Were there records in your home, your family home?

Some, but not a great deal. Actually, the earliest records I bought on my own and got some sort of phonograph. But radio was just coming in very strong, and that was influencing all of us. And so I had, I guess, one of the early Atwater Kents in my room, and I was able to listen to music and bands particularly, and stay awake all night. It was very nice.
